suite.name: SCG WireGuard (kernel-offload) Suite
suite.description: Benchmarks the SCG kernel WireGuard crypto provider. REQUIRES the privileged netns harness: run scripts/wg_setup.sh first (loads the wireguard module, installs/uses wireguard-tools, creates the peer network namespace + veth), drive these scenarios, then scripts/wg_teardown.sh. The generic `seshat run` path records WireGuard as skipped because kernel WireGuard needs CAP_NET_ADMIN and a separate netns for the peer gateway.
suite.author: SESHAT
